## Content checklist (new or changed prompts)

- [ ] Original text is imported verbatim (UTF-8, LF, one trailing newline); the source is linked in `meta.json`.
- [ ] Complete `en` and `zh-CN` templates and page copy; no shortened versions.
- [ ] Every `{{token}}` is declared in `parameters.json`, and every option has labels and replacements in both languages.
- [ ] License, attribution and a description of changes are recorded in `meta.json` and `ATTRIBUTION.md`.
- [ ] Example images are real, local, reviewed, with true dimensions and bilingual alt text — or the entry stays `draft`.
- [ ] Nothing claims a model or result was verified unless it was actually generated and recorded.
